title: Sugar is food only relative to the bacterium

statements.text: A motile bacterium swims up a sugar gradient because what it senses depends on how it moves and how it moves depends on what it senses. Sucrose is a real physicochemical condition, but its status as food is not intrinsic to the molecule. It is a relational feature tied to the bacterium’s metabolism, so the organism’s niche has a surplus of significance over the physicochemical environment.

sources.quote: That sucrose is a nutrient isn’t intrinsic to the structure of the sucrose molecule; it’s a relational feature, linked to the bacterium’s metabolism.
